Asset: 140 T-AXU-057 s01, ONE independent preparation-position photograph, portrait 4:5.
Input images 1,2,3 are strict identity, clothing, backdrop and photographic-style REFERENCES ONLY. Use the exact same adult East Asian woman with the same face, age, skin tone, proportions and black ponytail, plain white short-sleeve T-shirt and full-length dark charcoal trousers. White unbranded low-profile trainers. Do NOT copy the standing arm poses from these references.
Scene: softly lit gray-blue seamless photography studio with a gray-blue flat stable floor. A thin flat muted blue-gray exercise mat supports BOTH knees and lower legs, with no wobble cushion or ball. At the far LEFT of frame a securely floor-mounted rigid dark gray upright anchor post with a stable broad base has one reliable D-ring at a LOW position, about 55-60 cm above the floor. One simple blue resistance band is attached to this lateral D-ring and extends with gentle visible tension toward her hands, pulling from her anatomical RIGHT side (viewer left). Include the whole post base and band.
Pose s01: she is TALL KNEELING on BOTH knees, knees hip-width on the mat, shins resting on the mat behind her, feet naturally relaxed. Hips extended, pelvis directly over the knees, trunk erect and neutral, chest and pelvis facing straight FORWARD toward the camera, head naturally aligned, shoulders relaxed. She is NOT sitting back on heels and is NOT half-kneeling. Both hands securely clasp the free end of the band together at the LOWER CENTER OF HER CHEST, just in front of lower sternum. Both elbows comfortably bent and close beside the rib cage. The band approaches from the SIDE, not directly from the front. Do not rotate or bend her torso toward the anchor. No abdominal or muscle diagrams.
Composition: FIXED near-frontal full-body camera, just 15 degrees off exact front to show arm depth, both knees and relaxed lower legs/feet; natural 60mm lens feel without wide-angle distortion. Subject centered-right with space for the lateral anchor left. Include full head, complete hands, both knees, lower legs and shoes, all support contacts, entire mat and stable anchor base with margins. Normal adult anatomical proportions and correct hands with believable grip.
Soft studio illumination and subtle natural contact shadows, true high-quality realistic photograph matching reference background and light.
Text: NONE. No arrows, step labels, lettering, logo, watermark, collage, duplicate figure or ghost poses.
The ONLY posture is the chest-held preparation of tall-kneeling Pallof press.
